faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything people usually ask before buying.

trial.q: What is included in the free trial?
trial.a: For all 24 hours you get the full catalog, live Lock Screen wallpapers and the Bend effect. No card or registration required. The counter does not reset when you reinstall the app.

system.a: MacFlow requires macOS 15 (Sequoia) or later. It runs on Apple Silicon and Intel. Live Lock Screen and Screen Saver motion require macOS 26 (Tahoe) or later.

battery.q: How does the app affect battery life?
battery.a: Video is decoded on the hardware through VideoToolbox instead of the CPU. Playback pauses automatically behind full-screen apps, on low battery and in Low Power Mode. Actual usage depends on your Mac, the codec and the number of displays.

bends.a: When you close the MacBook lid, the display folds along with it — just like on flexible panels. Several modes are available: Duo, Ghost, Roll, Shutter, Flex and Iris. It needs the lid angle sensor and works on Apple laptops.

music.q: Do the wallpapers react to music?
music.a: Yes. The app includes Music Sync: wallpapers react to album art from Apple Music and Spotify, and the built-in player syncs volume and rhythm.

license.q: Is it a subscription or a one-time purchase?
license.a: One-time purchase. Premium forever costs 890 ₽ and never expires, including every future update. A lifetime license activates on up to three personal Macs.

devices.q: How many devices does one purchase cover?
devices.a: Premium forever covers three personal Macs. If you stop using one, deactivate it and activate the license on the new device. The yearly plan is limited to one Mac for the period of subscription.

payment.a: Payments go through Russian providers (LAVA or Robokassa): bank card, SBP and other available methods. Card details never reach the website — the provider handles the payment. Demo mode: purchase buttons show a placeholder.

import.q: Can I use my own videos?
import.a: Yes. Drag an MP4, MOV or M4V file into the app window and it is added to your library. Your files stay on your Mac and are never uploaded.

catalog.q: How often do new wallpapers arrive?
catalog.a: The catalog is updated several times a month. Premium users get new loops automatically — there is nothing extra to buy.

testimonials.title: What people are saying
testimonials.subtitle: Impressions from people who use MacFlow every day.

one.text: I've tried a lot of live wallpaper apps, but MacFlow is the first one that actually feels native to macOS. Clean UI, beautiful 4K wallpapers, and zero distractions like ads or sign-ups.
one.name: Artem Kovalev

two.text: I love that the catalog is small but every clip is genuinely high quality. The previews don't lie — what you see on the site is exactly what you get on your desktop. Bought Premium and never looked back.
two.name: Marina Sokolova

three.text: Set a moody “Rain at the window” loop as my desktop and my MacBook got quieter — the video is decoded through VideoToolbox instead of the CPU. The 24-hour trial was enough to decide.
three.name: Igor Dementyev

four.text: Great curation and a clean interface. Prices in rubles are a nice touch. I would love more playlist control from the site, but the app handles that even better.
four.name: Olga Veselova

five.text: Live wallpapers on the lock screen are something no built-in macOS tool can do. The app is stable on macOS 15 and the lid-fold animation looks stunning.
five.name: Dmitry Orlov

six.text: Being able to import my own clips matters. I build playlists for every mood — rain, sunset, city — and the app is remarkably gentle on the battery.
six.name: Alina Nesterova
